Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Chris Mullin?

Chris Mullin is 62 years old.

Where was Chris Mullin born?

Chris Mullin was born in New York, New York.

When was Chris Mullin born?

Chris Mullin was born on July 30, 1963.

How tall is Chris Mullin?

Chris Mullin is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much did Chris Mullin weigh when playing?

Chris Mullin weighed 215 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Chris Mullin in the Hall of Fame?

Chris Mullin was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2011 (Full List) .

When was Chris Mullin drafted?

Chris Mullin was drafted by Golden State Warriors, 1st round (7th pick, 7th overall), 1985 NBA Draft.

What position did Chris Mullin play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

When did Chris Mullin retire?

Chris Mullin last played in 2001.

What is Chris Mullin's net worth?

Chris Mullin made at least $40,424,600 playing professional basketball.

How much did Chris Mullin make?

Chris Mullin made $4,079,100 in 2000.

What did Chris Mullin average?

Chris Mullin averaged 18.2 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 3.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Chris Mullin have?

Chris Mullin won 0 championships.

What schools did Chris Mullin attend?

Chris Mullin attended Power Memorial in New York, New York, Xaverian in Brooklyn, New York and St. John's.

What are Chris Mullin's nicknames?

Mully is a nickname for Chris Mullin.
